business_rules: Aggregate verdict is the worst of exit_code_map[exitCode] and the highest-rank verdict observed in the stream.
The aggregate Signal is the LAST JSONL line on stdout — no other line may follow it.
Exit code 0 indicates the root ran and emitted its aggregate, regardless of verdict.
behavior.summary: Resolve the id to its sensor path, validate the JSON against schemas/sensor.json, resolve and run requires[kind=sensor] deps topologically (none in this fixture), spawn `sh -c <execution.command>`, stream stdout/stderr through the pattern matcher, and on exit fold (exit_code_map[exitCode], worst-stream-verdict) into one aggregate Signal.

description: Happy path: invoke /run-sensor on a sensor with type=computational + output=stream whose command exits 0 with no stream entries above the pass threshold. The runner emits zero individual Signals and exactly one aggregate Signal as the LAST JSONL line on stdout.

evidence.rationale: main() entry point of the computational runner.
RunOne / RunOneWithRoot performs DAG resolution + lifecycle execution + aggregate construction.

invariants: Exactly one aggregate Signal is emitted on stdout.
The aggregate's sensor_id equals the requested id.
expected_outcome.shape: JSONL on stdout; final line is the aggregate Signal
side_effects: No registry entry is written (sensor is non-blocking).
No files are created or modified in .harness/runtime/.
expected_outcome.summary: Stdout carries one JSON line, the aggregate Signal, with verdict=pass and severity=info.

name: Run a computational stream sensor whose command exits 0

preconditions: The subprocess exits 0 and emits no lines matching the pattern
trigger.summary: Agent invokes the run-computational script with a single bare sensor id.
